violations.text: The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200-400 pm. Sanitizing procedures reviewed with staff at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

Pita chips packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 11/04/2026

The slicer grip was observed in poor repair (worn down spikes). The grip must be maintained in good repair and proper adjustment. Per PIC, new grip has been ordered and is pending delivery. New Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2025
Prepared (TCS foods) that are packaged on-site are lacking expiration dates. Foods made on-site shall be disposed of within 7 days of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2025
